# Operations: Assemblies, joints and motion

Run with `./ise commit <operation> '<json parameters>'`, the MCP tool `ise_commit`, or `./ise run steps.json` for several at once (one undo step). 41 operations.

### `assembly.coupling.create`

drive one joint's value from another's.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `assembly` | StableId |  |  |
| `driver` | string | yes | The joint that drives (id or name). |
| `driver_key` | string |  |  |
| `follower` | string | yes | The joint that follows (id or name). |
| `follower_key` | string |  |  |
| `lead` | number |  | Screw: the lead, mm per turn. |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `offset` | number |  |  |
| `profile` | number[][] |  | Cam: [driver angle °, follower value] points over a turn. |
| `radius` | number |  | Rack and pinion: the pinion's pitch radius (mm). |
| `ratio` | number |  | Follower units per driver unit. Gears and belts may give `teeth` instead. |
| `teeth` | number[] |  | [driver teeth, follower teeth] (or pulley diameters for a belt). |
| `type` | CouplingKind | yes |  |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **CouplingKind**: `"gear"` (Meshing gears: the follower turns the other way, by teeth ratio.), `"belt"` (A belt or chain: same way round, by pulley teeth or diameters.), `"rack_pinion"` (A pinion turning (hinge) and a rack sliding (slider), by the pinion's pitch radius.), `"screw"` (A lead screw turning (hinge) and a nut sliding (slider), by the lead per turn.), `"cam"` (A cam turning and a follower lifting (or swinging) by a profile.), `"ratio"` (Any linear ratio between two values.)
- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>

### `assembly.joint.create`

join two instances (or one and the ground) at
their connectors.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `a` | End | yes | `{ instance, connector }`, "ground", or a ground frame `{ at, axis?, x? }`. |
| `aligned` | boolean |  |  |
| `assembly` | StableId |  | The assembly whose instances it joins (none: top-level instances). |
| `b` | End | yes | Placed on `a`: `{ instance, connector }`, "ground" or a ground frame. |
| `free` | boolean |  |  |
| `limits` | number[] |  | [min, max] of the main value. |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `offset` | number |  |  |
| `ranges` | object |  | [min, max] by key. |
| `type` | JointKind | yes |  |
| `value` | ValueIn |  | The main value (hinge/cylinder angle °, slider distance mm): a number or "=formula". |
| `values` | object |  | Values by key (angle, distance, rx, ry, rz). |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **End**: object \| object \| GroundWord \| object. One end of a joint.
- **Geometry**: object \| object \| object \| object \| object \| object \| object \| object. Geometry on an instance, in the instance's own coordinates (mm).
- **GroundWord**: `"ground"`
- **JointKind**: `"fixed"` (Held together, no motion.), `"hinge"` (Turns about the connector axis (value `angle`, degrees).), `"slider"` (Slides along it without turning (value `distance`, mm).), `"cylinder"` (Turns about and slides along it (`angle`, `distance`).), `"ball"` (Turns any way about the connector point (`rx`, `ry`, `rz`: degrees about X, then Y, then Z of the first connector's frame).), `"coincident"` (Points, lines and planes made to coincide (two faces meeting, a point on a face, an axis on a line).), `"concentric"` (Two axes made one (a shaft in a bore), or two centres.), `"parallel"` (Two directions (axes, face normals) parallel.), `"perpendicular"` (Two directions square.), `"angle"` (Two directions at an angle (value `angle`, degrees).), `"distance"` (Points, lines, planes a distance apart (value `distance`, mm).), `"tangent"` (A round face touching a flat or round one (a roller on a rail, a shaft in a V).), `"lock"` (Held exactly where it was against the other end when locked.)
- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.
- **ValueIn**: number \| string. A joint value as given: a number, or a formula ("=Arm.angle * 2").

</details>

### `assembly.pattern.create`

copies of an instance in a row or grid, round an axis, or along a path.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `align` | boolean |  | Path: copies turn with the path. |
| `angle` | ValueIn |  | Circular: degrees between copies; or `span` to spread them (360: all round). |
| `axis` | number[] |  | Circular: the axis (default Z) and a point on it (default the origin). |
| `center` | number[] |  |  |
| `closed` | boolean |  |  |
| `count` | integer | yes | How many, the seed included (along the first direction). |
| `count2` | integer |  | Linear grid: how many columns, how far apart, which way (default Y). |
| `direction` | number[] |  |  |
| `direction2` | number[] |  |  |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `path` | number[][] |  | Path: points (assembly coordinates) the copies spread along. |
| `seed` | StableId | yes | The instance copied (its assembly is the pattern's). |
| `spacing` | ValueIn |  | Linear: mm between copies (number or "=formula"), along `direction` (default X). |
| `spacing2` | ValueIn |  |  |
| `span` | number |  |  |
| `type` | PatternKind | yes |  |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **PatternKind**: `"linear"` (In a row along `direction`, `spacing` apart (and in columns along `direction2`).), `"circular"` (Round `axis` through `center`, `angle` apart.), `"path"` (Along a path (a polyline through points), spread evenly.)
- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.
- **ValueIn**: number \| string. A joint value as given: a number, or a formula ("=Arm.angle * 2").

</details>

### `assembly.robot.move_to`

set the chain's joints so the tool reaches a point
(and points its axis a way), within the joints' limits.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `axis` | number[] |  |  |
| `point` | number[] |  | Or a point in the tip's own coordinates. |
| `tip` | StableId | yes | The instance at the end of the chain (the gripper, the tool). |
| `to` | number[] | yes | The tool's point, assembly coordinates (mm). |
| `tool` | string |  | A connector on the tip for the tool point (default TCP / Tool / Tip, else its middle). |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>

### `comment.create`

start a thread pinned to the model.

Give the point either in the target's own coordinates (`point`) or in
project coordinates (`at`, converted to the target's). Without a target
the pin stays at a fixed project point.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | number[] |  | Point (mm) in project coordinates. |
| `author` | string | yes |  |
| `markup` | Stroke[] |  | Freehand strokes or arrows drawn on the model, in the same coordinates as the point. |
| `normal` | number[] |  | Surface direction there, in the same coordinates as the point. |
| `part` | string |  |  |
| `point` | number[] |  | Point (mm) in the target's own coordinates. |
| `target` | StableId |  |  |
| `text` | string | yes |  |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.
- **Stroke** (A freehand stroke drawn on the model with a comment: points (mm) in the anchor target's own coordinates, so the drawing moves with the part.): `arrow`?: boolean, `points`: number[][]

</details>

### `comment.reply`

answer in a thread (a reply reopens nothing; resolve or reopen separately).

A reply can carry markup too, drawn on the thread's part: give strokes in
the part's own coordinates (`markup`) or in project coordinates
(`markup_at`, converted). With markup, the text may be left empty.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `author` | string | yes |  |
| `markup` | Stroke[] |  | Strokes in the thread's part coordinates. |
| `markup_at` | Stroke[] |  | Strokes in project coordinates. |
| `text` | string |  |  |
| `thread` | StableId | yes | Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine. |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.
- **Stroke** (A freehand stroke drawn on the model with a comment: points (mm) in the anchor target's own coordinates, so the drawing moves with the part.): `arrow`?: boolean, `points`: number[][]

</details>

### `shape.config.import`

a shape's configuration table from a CSV or XLSX
table. The first column names the configurations; the others are
parameters (by key or label; values may carry units), and optionally
description, suppress and parts_off (lists separated by “;”). Replaces
the table, as `shape.config.set_table` does (instances keep showing a
configuration that is still there).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active` | string |  | The configuration to show ("" for none); left out, the active one stays if it is still there. |
| `base64` | string |  |  |
| `format` | string | yes | "csv" or "xlsx". |
| `sheet` | string |  |  |
| `target` | StableId | yes | Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine. |
| `text` | string |  |  |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>

### `shape.config.set_table`

create, edit or (with no rows and no columns)
remove a shape's configuration table. Columns are parameter keys; each
row gives every column a value. Linked parameters cannot be columns.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active` | string |  | The configuration the shape shows (its values are written into the shape's parameters); "" for none. Left out, the active one stays (following a rename). |
| `params` | string[] | yes | The parameters the table sets, by key, in column order. |
| `renamed` | object |  | Configurations renamed by this edit, old name → new, so instances showing them follow. |
| `rows` | ConfigRow[] | yes |  |
| `target` | StableId | yes | Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine. |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **ConfigRow** (One configuration: a value for every column of the table.): `description`?: string, `name`: string, `parts_off`?: string[], `suppress`?: string[], `values`: object
- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>
